items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: to the chagrin of Billy Taylor who was our regular bass player

ctx.x: It was Johnny Hodges and I that went to that little cafe in St. Louis and brought Blanton to the Chase Hotel in St. Louis and we said, Ellington, listen to this fellow. And so he listened to him play a few
numbers and naturally, he was so great, hired right then, to the chagrin of Billy Taylor who was our regular bass player, and so we had two bass players for awhile. Oh, Jimmy was terrific.
Did you and Johnny just happen in to the place where Jimmy was playing or had you heard about him?
